notes.title: You got your gift, now it's time to pay for it
notes.content:
[h1][b]You Weren't Naughty That Night... But That Doesn't Make You Innocent[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Dear Christmas Night Players,
Do you remember the cold sweat, trying to stay on Santa's list in Vanessa's room amidst the freezing cold of Alaska? [/p][p]You experienced firsthand what a fine line it is to be a "good kid." [/p][p][/p][p]Surviving that night didn't make you 'nice'. It just made you 'eligible' for the next level.
As SKYFOSTER, we invite those of you who loved the tension and desperation of that night to a brand new, darker game: [b]Final Signature![/b][/p][p]
This time, there's no Santa Claus to face. This time, there are the whispers of betrayal echoing through the walls of the abandoned [b]De'Manor Hotel[/b], and the fake smiles of the other contestants.
[/p][h2][b]The Rules Have Changed. No More Gifts, Only a Signature.[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Final Signature[/b] is a psychological horror contest that lures you in with the promise of a grand prize, but where the only real goal is to survive. You will choose who to trust, what secrets to keep, and most importantly, whether or not you'll sign the contract.[/p][p]
Remember, Santa only punished the naughty. The De'Manor Hotel forces everyone to pay a price.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065749/f60d5c211965b6957c5bde2888dad0c9a7b07181.png"][/img][/p][p]If you loved the tension of that night and are ready for a new nightmare filled with betrayal, your first step is clear:
[/p][p][b]Add Final Signature to your Steam Wishlist now and get the chance to be one of the first guests of this cursed hotel![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3600200/Final_Signature/"][/dynamiclink] [/p][p]After that cold Christmas night, can you handle this contract? [/p][p][/p][p][b]The SKYFOSTER & ALTERED GAMES Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Get ready to face your fears at DREAMSCAPE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065749/e1149da5d75ec8907e18820c2922cfb004411734.png[/img]

[h1][b]Brace yourselves for a fright! 😈 SKYFOSTER is bringing THREE spine-chilling games to DREAMSCAPE![/b][/h1]

Get ready to face your fears at [b]DREAMSCAPE[/b], Tokyo's horror indie game festival, on [b]September 7th![/b] We're thrilled to announce that we'll be showcasing THREE of our most terrifying titles, all classified under the [b]RED BAND category[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065749/88dade756a980e1bf617e59630f9604bf0350660.png[/img]

🩸 [b]Alessia's Dollhouse[/b]: Uncover the dark secrets lurking within the walls of a seemingly innocent dollhouse. This one is not for the faint of heart!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065749/ec87b9fd90f09fc2f2c0e1c62d9445b7728385be.png[/img]

🏨 [b]Hotel Greenwood[/b]: Check in, but you may never check out. Experience a night of terror in a hotel haunted by its gruesome past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065749/fd14503a1999ca0c9b6cfceb479e7c3c7be23e61.png[/img]

🎄 [b]Christmas Night[/b]: Who says the holidays have to be jolly? Prepare for a Christmas you won't forget (or survive) in this twisted festive nightmare.

Join us at [b]DREAMSCAPE[/b] for an unforgettable journey into the depths of horror. We dare you to play... if you think you can handle it. 😉

[b]#DREAMSCAPE #HorrorGames #IndieGames #SKYFOSTER #Tokyo #RedBand #GetReadyToScream[/b]
